paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 0 to $10^3$, and has tick labels at 0, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 55 with a tick label interval of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model, namely Base (black circle, solid line), FT (blue inverted triangle, solid line), IKE (red triangle, solid line), MEND (brown diamond, solid line), MEMIT (purple square, solid line), and ROME (green square, solid line). The Base line starts at around 28.5 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 32 at $10^3$. The FT line starts at around 31 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 38.5 at $10^3$. The IKE line starts at around 32.5 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 42.5 at $10^3$. The MEND line starts at around 36 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 46 at $10^3$. The MEMIT line starts at around 35 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 47 at $10^3$. The ROME line starts at around 44 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 58 at $10^3$. All lines show an overall increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
